verdict.rationale: RDAP evidence shows a live domain with status 'client transfer prohibited' etc., indicating a transfer lock is in effect, but there's no documentation that this is a default policy applied to all domains, and no mention of a registry-lock option for high-value domains. Community evidence highlights unrelated account-security weaknesses (PIN-based support takeover) that raise general trust concerns but don't directly contradict the lock feature. Missing for 10: explicit default-lock policy documentation, registry-lock offering, and independent confirmation of lock robustness.
